title: Stage 6 — MDS Legendary 2026 official recap
claims: The official stage 6 recap says the 40th edition covered 270 km; the final stage started at 06:30 and was 23.2 km with 238 m of elevation gain.

Maryline Nakache won all six stages of the 2026 MDS Legendary and claimed her third title in three participations; she won the final stage in 2:06 ahead of Magdalena Boulet (2:11) and Aziza El Amrany (2:18), with Desiree Linden and Aziza Raji completing the top five (2:24).
On the final stage, Mohamed El Morabity beat Ludovic Pommeret by a few seconds, with Rachid El Morabity third; sandstorm, rain and strong gusts marked the finishes.
